instruction: Rewrite the paragraph about the staged rollout so it is clearer and more specific. Leave the rest of the document exactly as it is.
edited_document:
# Release checklist

<!-- lark:block:s01 -->
## Scope

<!-- lark:block:s02 -->
This release covers the reader hardening work only. The writer changes that were originally planned for this release have been moved out, because the review found that they were not ready and would have needed another round of testing that there was simply not enough time for in this particular window.

<!-- lark:block:s03 -->
The rollout is staged: early consumers (the three sample projects currently on the beta channel) go first, with a 24-hour soak period before the change is promoted to the wider set. If any issues surface during the soak, the rollout pauses and does not proceed until they are resolved.

<!-- lark:block:s04 -->
## Open items

<!-- lark:block:s05 -->
- Confirm the changelog entry with the maintainer
- Re-run the download canary against the scratch document
- Decide whether the deprecation note ships in this release or the next one

<!-- lark:block:s06 -->
Nobody has yet confirmed which machine runs the checks during the rollout window, which is the one item that could actually block the release.

<!-- lark:block:s07 -->
## Status

<!-- lark:block:s08 -->
| Item | Owner | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Reader hardening | Maintainer | Done |
| Changelog | Maintainer | In review |
| Canary rerun | Maintainer | Not started |
